How to apply

🧼

1. Start with clean nails

Make sure your nails are free from oils and old polish. Push back your cuticles with the cuticle pusher provided.

💅

2. Buff & shape

Trim and buff your nails with the mini buffer provided for a neat, even, matte surface.

🏷️

3. Apply glue tabs

Wipe away dust and clean the nail with the alcohol pad. Apply a glue tab slightly smaller than your nail bed.

💨

4. Heat & stick tips

Warm the glue tabs slightly with a hair dryer for better grip. Gently place the press-on, leaving a little space near the cuticle, then glide it toward the cuticle and hold for a few seconds. That's it, you're ready to slay!

How to care for press-ons

🚿 Go easy on water

Avoid long soaks, hot tubs and heavy washing for the first hour after applying.

🧴 Moisturise

Use cuticle oil daily to keep the skin soft and the nails comfortable.

🔑 Not a tool

Don't use your nails to open cans or scrape things. Use your fingertips instead.

🫧 Gentle removal

Soak in warm, soapy water for 10 minutes and slide them off. Never pull or peel.

♻️ Reuse them

Clean off old glue, store in the box and they're ready for next time.
